title: A person's SIGINT stop of a foreground run-epic reads as the failed class (run_died → exit 1), the same conflation rix removed for cancelled words
body: cli.go's signal handler writes a run_died ('stopped by a signal (interrupt) before the run finished') for a person's Ctrl-C, and the watch classifies every run_died as FAILED/1 with 'the work has to be fixed and the epic run again'. A deliberate person-stop is the cancelled class's own case, not a failure to fix — the same distinction this tick made for the run_finished cancelled words. A future tick could split the deliberate signal stop from real deaths (an eviction, a panic) before the run_died stage, or teach the classifier the signal-stop detail.
